attributes.action: Mandatory Air Conditioning On TFL Buses
attributes.additional_details: Air conditioning should be mandatory on all TfL buses because London experiences increasingly hot summers, making bus journeys uncomfortable and, in some cases, dangerous for passengers. Excessive heat can affect elderly people, young children, pregnant women, and those with medical conditions. Installing air conditioning would create a more pleasant travel environment, encourage greater use of public transport, improve passenger wellbeing, and make journeys safer and more reliable in heatwaves.
attributes.background: TfL buses should have mandatory air conditioning because summer temperatures can make journeys uncomfortable and sometimes unsafe, especially for elderly, disabled, and vulnerable passengers. Air conditioning would improve comfort, reduce heat related risks and make public transport more attractive.

rejection.details:
We can't accept your petition because the UK Government and Parliament aren't responsible for the issue you raise. It is the responsibility of Transport for London, the Mayor of London and the London Assembly.

The London Assembly has its own petitions process. You can find out more about how to petition the London Assembly here: https://www.london.gov.uk/about-us/london-assembly/petitions

We could accept a petition calling for the Government to change the requirements for all buses in England, as these are regulated by the UK Government.
